title: Evidence Gate adapter config
description: Says WHICH URL, button or field to use for one app. Written once per app. Type 'http' talks to an API; type 'browser' drives a web page with Playwright.

type.description: Kind of driver that runs this adapter.

base_url.description: Address of the running app. Local test copy only, never production.

before_each.description: Steps run before every scenario, for example resetting data.

actions.description: Named operations. Task examples point to them with via: adapter.action.

safety.description: Limits that keep the Gate from touching anything it should not.

allowed_hosts.description: Only these hosts may be called.

blocked_paths.description: URL path patterns that must never be called.

blocked.description: Extra blocked items (for example words or selectors). Format is defined by the engine owner.

max_requests_per_run.description: Stop after this many requests in one run.

context.description: Extra information that never decides a label.

tests_command.description: Command that runs the existing tests. Their result is context only.

health.description: (http only) How to ask the running app which commit it runs.

request.description: Request to send, for example GET /api/health.

commit_field.description: JSONPath of the commit in the response, for example $.commit.

headless.description: (browser only) Run the browser without a window.

channel.description: (browser only) Installed browser to use, for example msedge. Null uses Playwright's Chromium.

timeout_ms.description: (browser only) How long to wait for a page or element, in milliseconds.

request.description: Request to send, for example POST /path.

http.description: HTTP call to make, for example POST /path.

request.description: Request to send, for example POST /api/cart/quote.

defaults.description: Input values used when an example does not give them.

body.description: Request body. "{name}" placeholders are replaced with input values.

read.description: Result fields to collect: name to JSONPath.

defaults.description: Input values used when an example does not give them.

steps.description: Browser steps in order. Open objects; the browser driver owner defines the details.

read.description: Values to read from the page. Open objects; the browser driver owner defines the details.

screenshot.description: Save a screenshot for the report.
